overall: The Board violated the Open Meeting Law by posting an insufficiently specific notice for its July 22 meeting. The AG ordered immediate and future compliance and declined the requested mailing and outline remedies.

allegations.summary: Complaint said the July 22 notice listing 'zoning bylaw recodification' was too vague, because the Board also discussed substantive bylaw changes.
allegations.key_passage: Because notice of the July 22 meeting did not list as a topic the consideration of substantive amendments to the bylaws, we find it insufficiently specific.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the law’s requirements
remedy_passage: We order immediate and future compliance with the law’s requirements
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
